content.overview: Section 191 provides that a ‘sub-agent’ is a person employed by, and acting under the control of, the original agent in the business of the agency.
content.glance: A sub-agent is a person employed by, and acting under the control of, the original agent in the business of the agency.
content.study: Section 191 provides that a ‘sub-agent’ is a person employed by, and acting under the control of, the original agent in the business of the agency. This is the statutory rule under Section 191 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872. Apply the elements stated in the text; do not extend beyond the provision. sections.heading: Definition
sections.body: A ‘sub-agent’ is a person employed by, and acting under the control of, the original agent in the business of the agency.

examples.title: Employed and controlled by original agent
examples.body: A person employed by the original agent and acting under that agent’s control in the business of the agency is a sub-agent under Section 191.

hypotheticals.question: Who is a sub-agent?
hypotheticals.analysis: A person employed by, and acting under the control of, the original agent in the business of the agency, under Section 191.

enhancement.detailedExplanation: Section 191 defines a sub-agent as a person employed by, and acting under the control of, the original agent in the business of the agency. This definition governs the subsequent provisions on sub-agents.
examples: A helper employed and controlled by the original agent in the agency business is a sub-agent.
distinctions: Distinct from a person named by the agent who becomes an agent of the principal under Section 194.
problemApplication: Identify employment by the original agent.
Identify control by the original agent in the business of the agency.
